name: Talking About Someone
overview: Scripture instructs believers to carefully guard their speech, recognizing that controlling the tongue protects life and reflects true religion, as seen in Psalms 141:3 and James 1:26. Believers are called to avoid judgmental and corrupt communication, instead speaking words that build up and offer grace, following the commands of Matthew 7:1 and Ephesians 4:29. Furthermore, kindness, tenderheartedness, and forgiveness should characterize how we talk about others, mirroring God's forgiveness through Christ as taught in Ephesians 4:32.
